true_answer: According to general relativity, time also runs slower in stronger gravitational ﬁelds; this is gravitational time dilation.[99] e eﬀect of the dilation becomes more noticeable in a mass-dense object. A famous example of time dilation is a thought experiment of a subject approaching the event horizon of a black hole. As a consequence of how gravitational ﬁelds warp spacetime, the subject will experience gravitational time dilation. From the perspective of the subject itself, they will experience time normally.
